items.name: HomogeneousLocalization.NumDenSameDeg.den_smul
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {σ : Type u_3} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : SetLike σ A] {𝒜 : ι → σ} (x : Submonoid A)
  {α : Type u_4} [inst_2 : SMul α A] [inst_3 : SMulMemClass σ α A] (c : HomogeneousLocalization.NumDenSameDeg 𝒜 x)
  (m : α), ↑(m • c).den = ↑c.den
